test_title: PYST 20: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the one that does NOT belong to that group?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic :

 
• First and second letter → Difference between the position value according to the English alphabetic series is 2.
 
• Second and third letter → Difference between the position value according to the English alphabetic series is 1.

​​So,​

 
• Option - (1) : WYZ

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2bade4d0579819dc57a5b4cb6108ae6ebd89a03925805a301b5a5f020db713d9.png] 

 
• Option - (2) : EGH

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62dbca9020d031c961f0db79b02719e078133da1e40dc5b4eadeed459ef3875b.png] 

 
• Option - (3) : CEF

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8acf65c1eb0431a87ee84df9a7494b28c18bb612335a28970d48908a399ce7d7.png] 

 
• Option - (4) : TVX

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff94053510dc6e22cb55fd9179834843f19d06a2fd2b90844f64335ce10c42c1.png] 

Here, out of all options only 'TVX' doesn't follow the same logic as given.

Hence, "TVX" is the correct answer.
